_doc: What the Tern fights with in the coop-drill (openspec/changes/coop-drill design 2.2-2.4). hull_mj and hit_radius_m are placeholders: the hull is damage-control's, and the hit test becomes the shield ellipsoid of weapons-and-shields 9. Turret arcs are the placeholder for the hull mask (weapons-and-shields 2): dorsal bears from -10 to +90 deg of elevation, ventral from +10 to -90. Mount positions are ship-local metres.
